[EN] met a scout from the Baaldaz Post and learned the location of Archdeva Temporary Post. Using the truth needle, seized a dark magic map.
[ES] se encontró con un explorador del Baaldaz Post y descubrió la ubicación del Archdeva Temporary Post. Usando la aguja de la verdad, se apoderó de un mapa de magia oscura.

[EN] One of my scouts reported archdevan activity nearby in Verdantfire Rift. They are excavating something, but we do not know what.

Seek the scout; his name is Marat. He knows every archdevan camp and patrol in the area. He will know where to find what you seek."I'll talk to him."
[ES] Uno de mis exploradores informó sobre actividad archdeva cerca de Verdantfire Rift. Están excavando algo, pero no sabemos qué.

Busca al explorador; se llama Marat. Conoce todos los campamentos y patrullas archdevas de la zona. Sabrá dónde encontrar lo que buscas."I'll talk to him."

[EN] Greetings, outlander. Welcome to our land.

I am sorry to say that I have not seen any sort of apparatus which might somehow affect the Storm Barrier, but I suspect that only their most trusted officers would know where it might be found.

Hm. As luck would have it, there is a high-ranking officer in their cave camp, just inside the Verdantfire Rift. Follow the path just over the hill, then look to your left. You should see the cave entrance."Leave it to me."
[ES] Saludos, forastero. Bienvenido a nuestras tierras.

Lamento decir que no he visto ningún tipo de aparato que de algún modo pueda afectar la Storm Barrier, pero sospecho que solo sus oficiales de mayor confianza sabrían dónde se encuentra.

Mñe. Da la casualidad de que hay un oficial de alto rango en su campamento en la cueva, justo dentro de Verdantfire Rift. Sigue el sendero pasando la colina y luego mira a tu izquierda. Deberías ver la entrada de la cueva."Leave it to me."

[EN] What was that you...?

I feel odd...like I've drunk too much wine...are we at the beach yet? I want to work on my tan.

We can't stay long...I need to get back to the Energia Celo...it's my shift!"I'll get you back. Where is it, again?"
[ES] ¿Qué fue eso que...?

Me siento raro... como si hubiera bebido demasiado vino... ¿ya estamos en la playa? Quiero broncearme.

No podemos quedarnos mucho tiempo... necesito volver a Energia Celo... ¡es mi turno!"I'll get you back. Where is it, again?"

[EN] The entrance...it always changes...need the shifting map... "Right! The map! Where did you put it?"
[ES] La entrada... siempre cambia... necesito el mapa cambiante... "Right! The map! Where did you put it?"

[EN] It's inside this chest...but you should know that. Why don't you...?

Wait...who are you? How did you get in here?Back off
[ES] Está dentro de este cofre... pero deberías saberlo. ¿Por qué no... ?

Espera... ¿quién eres? ¿Cómo entraste aquí?Back off

[EN] Oh, thank you, outlander!

But, please: There are more prisoners above. Do you see that ladder? They're all up there.

Please, you have to help them, too!"Don't worry."
[ES] ¡Oh, gracias, forastero!

Pero, por favor: hay más prisioneros arriba. ¿Ves esa escalera? Están todos ahí arriba.

¡Por favor, tienes que ayudarlos también!"Don't worry."

[EN] Free!

Thank you, stranger! You saved me!"I'll draw them off. When I do—run!"
[ES] ¡Libre!

¡Gracias, extraño! ¡Me salvaste!"I'll draw them off. When I do—run!"

[EN] I'll help you fight them! Just...need to...get my strength back..."Plenty of time for that later. I've got this."
[ES] ¡Te ayudaré a luchar contra ellos! Solo... necesito... recuperar mis fuerzas..."Plenty of time for that later. I've got this."

[EN] I was waiting for you, !
Hagand told me about his research on the devastones you gathered for him.

He thinks the archdevas use it for their blood magic, which explains why they were so keen to protect it.

If we can find their lab, we can probably rescue some of their victims."I have a map to their laboratory."
[ES] ¡Te estaba esperando, !
Hagand me habló sobre su investigación acerca de las devastones que recolectaste para él.

Cree que los archdevas las usan para su magia de sangre, lo que explica por qué tenían tanto empeño en protegerlas.

Si podemos encontrar su laboratorio, probablemente podamos rescatar a algunas de sus víctimas."I have a map to their laboratory."

[EN] You know where it is? Excellent!

Maybe now we can get to the bottom of this...and re-enable the teleportal to Velika!"You might be right. One way to find out."
[ES] ¿Sabes dónde está? ¡Excelente!

¡Tal vez ahora podamos llegar al fondo de esto... y reactivar el teleportal a Velika!"You might be right. One way to find out."
